finish_summary: All tests executed against module `cart`. The only discrepancy found is that `Cart.total(member=True, coupon="SAVE20")` was expected to be 830.00 based on the specification: subtotal 1000, coupon 20% → 800; shipping for non‑member would be 60 but member pays half (30) so total = 830. The implementation produced a different value, indicating that the module does not follow its specification regarding member discounts and shipping fees. No other spec violations were detected.
